**Every frame the API's four streams push has one typed description.** `docs/reference/events.schema.json`, committed beside `openapi.json` and generated by `python -m openfactory.api.events`, names one envelope — `Envelope`: `kind`, `id`, `at`, `project`, `product` when one applies, `data` — and a data model per kind: `HelloData`, `UpdateData`, `ByeData`, `SubscribedData`, `HistoryData`, `EarlierData`, `SaidData`, `ReplyData`, `StagedData`, `PresenceData`, `AckData`, `RefusedData`, `ResyncData`, `JobsData` (the temporal stream's frame, `jobs: null` when the engine cannot be read, with the engine UI's `ui_base` and `ui_hint`), `LogData` (one line of a run's log) and `EndedData` (`why`, `status`, the refusal's `detail`, and `login` when the provider has a login page). `product` is required for the kinds a product conversation emits and absent for the rest. It is a description only: the streams themselves send what they sent before, and none sends the envelope yet. A test reads the streams' code and fails when it writes a kind or a field the models do not name.
